backwards: a character range that runs backwards
classBackslash: a backslash at the end of a character class
classUnclosed: a character class with no closing `]`
emptyClass: a character class with no members
expected: a pattern is expected to hold {token} here
noCountTerm: a counted repetition (`'{m,n}'`) with no term before it
noTerm: a repeat (`*`, `+` or `?`) with no term before it
patternBackslash: a backslash at the end of the pattern
strayBrace: a `'}'` with no `'{'` before it (a literal brace is `\'}'`)
tooDeep: a pattern that nests more than 250 levels deep
